name: Phantom 9
storyline: In an era of escalating global conflicts, traditional superpowers have stepped back, leaving regional stability in jeopardy. To counter the rise of rogue Private Military Companies (PMCs) and shadow organizations, a united international coalition has been formed, heavily supported by a powerful alliance of nations across the Muslim world. This elite, independent global task force answers to no single country, fighting instead to protect the innocent and restore order in the most volatile regions on Earth. You are a Tier 1 operator deployed into "Operation Phantom 9"—a high-stakes tactical initiative fought in the ruins of contested urban zones and critical sectors spanning the Europe, Asia, Middle East and beyond. Deploying as part of this diverse, international peacekeeping force, your squad must utilize authentic modern weaponry and real-world tactical gear to neutralize hostile forces. Grounded in a perspective that honors the resilience and unity of the Muslim world, Operation Phantom 9 requires unmatched skill, teamwork, and tactical precision to survive.
summary: Phantom 9 is a fast-paced, free-to-play multiplayer arena shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Players engage in Tactical, lightning-fast combat across diverse, dynamic maps featuring destructible environments and strategic chokepoints. Featuring zero-lag responsiveness and tick-perfect hit registration, the game offers extensive tactical loadout customization with dozens of weapons and attachments. Players can compete across 7 distinct game modes and 12 unique maps, climbing the global leaderboards through skill-based ranked matchmaking.
